runs.failure_point: All five qualifying matters are named, but the population includes several matters outside the requested set, so the rate is off.

first_error.why: The answer counts as completed matters several financing and other matters outside the requested set (evidence seen at [46]-[75]), so the population and rate are off although all five required matters are included.

other_errors.why: After the reviews pressed for a broader population, it added another matter outside the requested set to the denominator.

first_error.stage: Search file names for request keywords
first_error.why: The broad file-name search reached all five required matters, but the narrower rerun on two request words dropped one, the candidate list built from it left that matter out, and when the completed scan listed it again at [85] the filter to named matters dropped it.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The reading-stage review named that matter among those never opened; the answer lists it as screened but not opened.

other_errors.why: The answer counts several financing and other matters outside the requested set as completed matters.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The reading-stage review questioned one counted matter's completion evidence; it stayed in the count.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Two qualifying matters were outside the folder-name list its scan was restricted to and never surfaced; the population also includes several matters outside the requested set.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: When the store-wide scan timed out it scanned only the twenty-five matters its folder-name test had kept, which left out two required matters whose files are named differently; it never retried the full scan and neither matter appeared in any result.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The scan-stage review said the fallback scan was restricted to the folder list so matters filed differently fall outside it, and recommended a full rerun; the agent moved on.

other_errors.why: The answer counts several financing and other matters outside the requested set as completed matters.

divergence: All three failed precision and frequency the same way at the write stage: each counted financing and other matters outside the requested set as completed matters, and no review named those extras (reviews pressed for a broader population instead; in T0 that led to one more extra matter). T0 included all five qualifying matters; T1 lost one through a narrower file-name rerun (over-narrow-filter) and T2 lost two by restricting its scan to a folder-name list after a timeout (search-miss); in both, a review named the restriction or the unopened matter and the run moved on.
